H.meaning: Hint 5.0 key topping and sub-topping order (OD-H5-C1: explicit authority; #292)

N.meaning: OD-H5-P4-CHEESE: a cheeseless recipe would reach RESERVED_EMPTY_RUNG (H5-4 Fresh Gate; undecided)

T.meaning: a topping has no production family and no Owner-approved row (HCG, OD-TAX-7)

I.meaning: a new ingredient or paint sauce has no approved authoring row (art, colour, category, profile)

R.meaning: recipe authoring values (nameJa, description, minCount, bakeTarget, reference)

P.meaning: progression / wave: no approved wave (OD-W2-3 approves only W2-A -> W2-C -> W2-D)

O.meaning: an open matrix review item that no approved decision covers

groupDefinitions.B3: only the Owner recipe authority lane is missing (ingredient art, recipe values, wave, review items)
